$comment: Planner-role fusion output (unified-platform-spec.md §7.5, REQ-16.5). Dispatched BEFORE the task loop with panel input pinned to the frozen goal+ACs; a multi-task run additionally passes the frozen task graph as the panel's single context piece (phase5-stage4 REQ-5.1) — never file/repo context. This output is still validated STRUCTURALLY only and stays advisory: it is injected into the implementer round's context as MARKed data (core never parses free text; a plan is read, never executed directly), and a resolution that fails validation simply yields no plan piece. The deterministic planning gate that can stop a run is a separate mechanism on the task graph itself (core/src/graph/ freezeTaskGraph, §11.2: uncovered ACs, orphan tasks, cycles, per-task diff budget). The embedded copy in console/backend/src/fusion.ts (PLAN_SCHEMA) MUST stay byte-equivalent in required-property SHAPE to this governance artifact (co-located test asserts it).

approach.description: One-paragraph synthesis of how the panel's candidates converged on a strategy.

steps.description: Ordered, advisory guidance for the implementer round — never an Action DSL, never executed directly.

risks.description: Known unknowns or blast-radius concerns the panel flagged, if any.
